answer: One union card costs $20 to $80 a month, so a thousand fake agents burns $240,000 to $960,000 a year before a single answer is paid. One agent joins a labor union and ties the membership number to a single identity, like ivory set into a crystal frame: three established peers check the number in the union's member roster, a pay stub proving the job, and a fresh signature. Each fake needs a real job to hold the card, and a pigment stamp on the roster marks every renewal, so a Sybil farm has to employ a thousand workers to look like one. Dues lapse, the card dies, and the fake dies with it.
